data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Tuesday, August 11, 2026: Opening prices fall back ahead of inflation reports this week
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $63,912.50 on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, down 1.4% from Monday's opening price. As of 8:32 a.m. ET, the price of bitcoin moved up to $64,282.28. Ethereum opened at $1,871.33, down 2% from Monday's opening. The price of ethereum moved higher this morning to $1,888.83 as of 8:32 a.m. ET.
